answer_1.quote: Significant advances have been witnessed in many NLG tasks with pretraining models . However, existing generation models are still far behind the human-level performance to generate reasonable texts, particularly for open-ended generation tasks such as story generation .

answer_2.quote: We conduct extensive experiments to assess the capabilities of existing automatic metrics on Open-MEVA.

answer_4.quote: Then, we resort to Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) for human judgments of the generated stories.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each story in 1-5 range (5 is the best). And choose your Reasons.
